services.name: Shared Dolphin Tours
services.desc: Dolphins have to be conscious to breath, this means that they cannot go into a full deep sleep, because then they would suffocate. Dolphins have “solved” that by letting one half of their brain sleep at a time. This has been determined by doing EEG studies on dolphins. Dolphins sleep about 8 hours day in this fashion.

services.name: How deep can dolphins dive?
services.desc: The deepest dive ever recorded for a bottlenose dolphin was a 300 meters (990 feet). This was accomplished by Tuffy, a dolphin trained by the US Navy. blurb: Guests cruise the estuaries around Pinckney Island National Wildlife Refuge to see Atlantic Bottlenose Dolphins in their natural habitat. Tours depart from the dock behind The Skull Creek Boathouse and include wildlife viewing and local history commentary by a Master Captain. Sunset cruises offer a 2-hour relaxing experience watching the sunset over the water.
